## One member restarts, its peers up (computed from the build times above and cited rates)

Local open work per resource: open its group from stored state, an empty fold, its settings, group record, slot table and name: 17.8 µs; its entry re-announced at an indexed directory host: 3.57 µs. Dormant: 0.65 µs (one index entry). Journal replay: 1 to 3 small records per resource at E-05's 223,000 to 328,000 records a second (fero v4's codec). Failover: the member led about R/3 groups; their followers stand after election.ms plus up to election.jitter (2 to 2.5 s in TypeScript, DESIGN-V5 4.2), so R/3 elections at once on the two survivors (reasoned; the boot runs below measure R elections at once on three). Hand-back: once back and caught up for settle.ms (30 s), it takes back its R/3 preferred leaderships at ten a second (DESIGN-V5 4.2). A roll that goes on as soon as a member has caught up overlaps the hand-backs: leaders then stay uneven for about the roll's own length plus one hand-back.

## Cold boot of three processes, by who stands first (boot.mjs)

random-e26: Raft's random timers, E-26's timing (500 ms ticks, a timeout of 4 to 7 ticks: 2 to 3.5 s). random-v5: random timers, DESIGN-V5's timing (100 ms ticks, 20 ticks plus 0 to 5: 2 to 2.5 s). preferred-e26: E-26's start campaign (each group's preferred process campaigns at once), as cluster.mjs. dep13: the same preferred boot, for memory (RSS 20 s after a forced collection). dep13w40: the same, read 40 s after it (added after the re-check). Boot = spawn to every group led on all three. Off-preferred = groups a process should lead but another leads; hand-back = settle.ms 30 s + the largest off-preferred count / 10 a second (computed).
